In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''line cook''' worked in the [[Original TaunTaun Steak Company]], based on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]]. He assisted a representative of the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] in the rescue of his fellow [[Chef/Legends|cook]] [[Nuura Yendo]], made captive by the [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] group [[The Brothers]].<ref name="Dash" />
